populate_metadata: populate author, category, and tag metadata pages from a Pelican article generator
read_pages: read metadata page files from a configured directory path using a Pelican article generator
register_pelican_signal: register the populate_metadata function as a Pelican article generator finalized signal handler
review_populate_metadata: review the populate_metadata function that attaches badge, image, and twitter attributes to authors and categories
refactor_read_pages: refactor the _read_pages function to support additional metadata file formats beyond Pelican readers
